Riley: Tiny morale thread: what single song, single TV episode or movie, and single book got you through a rough week recently? No explanations required but feel free to add one sentence.
Nora: Song: "Heroes" - David Bowie. Ep: "Parks and Rec" S03E02 (Ron/Lil Sebastian) Movie: "About Time". One sentence: silly, sincere, helps.
Ben: Song: "Dog Days Are Over" - Florence + The Machine. Ep: "Ted Lasso" S01E01. Book: "The Art of Racing in the Rain". Short note: sob-laugh combo.
Isha: Song: instrumental playlist (focus mix) // Ep: "Atlanta" S02E06 (Teddy Perkins) // Book: "Braiding Sweetgrass". Calm and weird in the best way.
Kai: Song: "September" - Earth, Wind & Fire. Movie: "The Grand Budapest Hotel". Book: "Good Omens" for ridiculous comfort.
Riley: Love the variety. Tiny follow-up poll: do we want a shared "week-salvage" playlist + a small book-recs doc? React with :musical_note: for playlist, :books: for doc, :sparkles: for both.
(Nora reacts :sparkles:)
(Ben reacts :musical_note:)
(Isha reacts :books:)
(Kai reacts :sparkles:)
PlaylistBot: Created playlist "week-salvage-picks" and posted link in channel: https://redwood.example/playlist/week-salvage-picks :robot_face
Riley: Thanks @PlaylistBot. I'll drop a tiny Google doc for book entries and print two bookmarks for the office bookshelf. Isha, can you help with design?
Isha: Happy to. Minimal aesthetic, maybe a quote from each rec.
Ben: If anyone wants a physical mixtape instead of streaming, I will trade you a sticker for a burned CD. Retro economy.
Nora: Deal. This turned into micro-therapy but cheaper. Appreciative vibes.
Riley: Closing note: if this helped, maybe tag your pick with #week-salvage so folks can search later. Good vibes only. :heart:
